adjudication.evidence: P1 (533–550) shows a sustained N/E shift but no clear return; E/U residuals remain noisy and offset persists beyond end. P2 (547–560) overlaps P1 and lacks interior stability; onset offset in E is large (-1.05), but residual plots show no clean platform—E drops sharply at ~552 (coincident with P3 start) and continues downward, suggesting a permanent step, not a temporary offset. P3 (552–582) has extreme offsets (-2.77, -14.71, -9.61), but residuals after subtraction (Hypothesis P3) show persistent low-frequency motion and no clean return to pre-event level; U recovers partially but E remains depressed. No candidate exhibits a sustained shift followed by an opposing return across same axes. Independent step at ~552 (E drop) likely contaminates all three. No genuine temporary platform identified.
